paras.text: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,
paras.loc: on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 2

paras.text: Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, and in particular Article 291(2) thereof,
paras.loc: on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 3

paras.text: Having regard to Regulation (EU) 2024/1620 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 31 May 2024 establishing the Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism and amending Regulations (EU) No 1093/2010, (EU) No 1094/2010 and (EU) No 1095/2010 ( 1 ) , and in particular Article 63 thereof,
paras.loc: on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 4

paras.text: Whereas:
paras.loc: on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 5
on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 6

paras.text: On 31 May 2024, the European Parliament and the Council adopted Regulation (EU) 2024/1620 establishing the Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (the ‘Authority’).
paras.loc: on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 7
on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 8

paras.text: Article 63 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1620 provides for the Executive Board of the Authority, composed of the Chair of the Authority and five full-time members, including the Vice-Chair. Those five full-time members are to be appointed by the Council, acting by qualified majority, following the submission to the European Parliament of a proposal of the General Board of the Authority, based on the shortlist of qualified candidates drawn up by the Commission, and the approval of that proposal by the European Parliament. That Article also provides for a term of office for the five full-time members of the Executive Board of four years.
paras.loc: on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 9
on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 10

paras.text: On 22 May 2025, the Council adopted an Implementing Decision ( 2 ) on the appointment of four full-time members of the Executive Board of the Authority.
paras.loc: on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 11
on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 12

paras.text: On 12 November 2025, the Commission prepared a shortlist of candidates for the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the Authority, and provided it to the European Parliament. The Council was informed of the shortlist on the same day.
paras.loc: on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 13
on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 14

paras.text: On 9 December 2025, the General Board of the Authority adopted a proposal for the appointment of Mrs Henrica Maria VERBEEK-KUSTERS as full-time member of the Executive Board of the Authority, and submitted it to the European Parliament for approval. On 18 December 2025, the European Parliament approved the proposal for the appointment of the member of the Executive Board of the Authority.
paras.loc: on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 15
on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 16

paras.text: The fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the Authority should therefore be appointed,
paras.loc: on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 17

paras.text: HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION:
paras.loc: on the appointment of the fifth full-time member of the Executive Board of the A, para 18

paras.text: Mrs Henrica Maria VERBEEK-KUSTERS is hereby appointed as a full-time member of the Executive Board of the Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism for a term of office of four years from 1 April 2026.
paras.loc: Article 1, para 1

paras.text: This Decision shall enter into force on the date of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union .
